description:
The Sardar Patel Agriculture Research Award was established to honor the contributions of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel to the agricultural sector in India.

This award aims to promote excellence in agricultural research and innovation.

The award was instituted by the Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) in the year 1997.

It is named after Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel who played a pivotal role in the integration of Indian states and the development of agriculture.

The primary objective of the Sardar Patel Agriculture Research Award is to recognize outstanding research work in agriculture.

The award seeks to encourage scientists and researchers to contribute to the advancement of agricultural practices in India.

The award is given annually to individuals or teams who have made significant contributions to agricultural research.

The award includes a cash prize of INR 2 lakh.

In addition to the cash prize, recipients receive a citation and a medal.

The award is open to researchers working in various fields of agriculture including crop science, horticulture, animal husbandry, and agricultural engineering.

Eligibility for the award includes researchers who have made significant contributions to agricultural research in India.

There are no specific age limits for applicants.

However, the research work must have been conducted in India.

The research must have been published in recognized journals or presented at national or international conferences.

The application process for the Sardar Patel Agriculture Research Award involves submitting a detailed application form.

Applicants must provide a comprehensive summary of their research work.

This summary should highlight the significance and impact of the research on agriculture.

The application must also include a list of publications related to the research.

Additionally, applicants are required to submit letters of recommendation from peers or mentors in the field.

The deadline for submitting applications is typically set for the end of June each year.

The award is presented during the annual ICAR Foundation Day celebrations on July 29.

The selection committee for the award consists of eminent scientists and researchers from various agricultural disciplines.

The committee evaluates the applications based on the originality and impact of the research.

They also consider the practical applications of the research in improving agricultural practices.

The award aims to inspire young researchers to pursue careers in agricultural science.

It also seeks to foster collaboration among researchers across different agricultural disciplines.

The Sardar Patel Agriculture Research Award has contributed to enhancing the visibility of agricultural research in India.

It has also played a role in promoting sustainable agricultural practices.

The award highlights the importance of research in addressing challenges such as food security and climate change.

Since its inception, the award has recognized numerous researchers who have made significant contributions to agriculture.

The award has helped in creating a culture of research and innovation in the agricultural sector.

It has also encouraged researchers to focus on issues relevant to Indian agriculture.

The award serves as a platform for showcasing innovative agricultural research.

It has also facilitated the dissemination of research findings to a wider audience.

The award has been instrumental in promoting interdisciplinary research in agriculture.

It encourages researchers to collaborate with other sectors such as environmental science and technology.

The award has also contributed to the development of policies aimed at improving agricultural productivity.

The recognition from the award enhances the credibility of researchers in the agricultural community.

It also opens up opportunities for further funding and collaboration for awardees.

The award has been a source of motivation for many young scientists in India.

It has encouraged them to engage in research that addresses real-world agricultural challenges.

The Sardar Patel Agriculture Research Award is a testament to the importance of research in agriculture.

It underscores the need for continuous innovation in agricultural practices to meet the demands of a growing population.

The award has also helped in building a network of researchers committed to advancing agricultural science.

It has fostered a spirit of competition among researchers to excel in their fields.

The award is a significant recognition in the field of agricultural research in India.

It highlights the contributions of researchers towards achieving national goals in food security and sustainability.

The award has also been aligned with various national initiatives aimed at improving agricultural productivity.

It supports the government's vision of a self-reliant India in terms of agricultural production.

The Sardar Patel Agriculture Research Award is one of the prestigious awards conferred by ICAR.

It reflects the government's commitment to promoting research in agriculture.

The award is an important part of India's efforts to enhance agricultural research and innovation.

It plays a crucial role in ensuring that agricultural research is relevant and impactful.

The award has helped in building a legacy of excellence in agricultural research in India.

It continues to inspire future generations of agricultural scientists and researchers.

The Sardar Patel Agriculture Research Award is a vital component of India's agricultural research ecosystem.

It serves as a reminder of the importance of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel's contributions to the nation.

The award encourages researchers to think creatively and develop solutions for the agricultural sector.

It is a symbol of recognition for hard work and dedication in the field of agricultural research.

The award has a lasting impact on the agricultural landscape of India.

It promotes a culture of excellence and innovation in agricultural research.

The Sardar Patel Agriculture Research Award is a significant milestone in recognizing the importance of agricultural research in India.
